title: Emergency department wait times by hospital and triage level
what: South−North median wait gap at triage level 3 (min), or the two medians

reader_questions.question: At triage level 3, how many minutes longer is the median wait at South than at North?
reader_questions.expected: About 10.3 minutes longer (~49.3 min at South vs ~39.0 min at North).

reader_questions.question: How is wait-time skewness represented?
reader_questions.expected: Medians with IQR/spread rather than means alone.

reader_questions.question: Is South slower across all triage levels?
reader_questions.expected: No — urgent triage levels 1–2 are similar; South is slower only for less urgent levels 3–5.
